pbq.stem: Configure firewall rules for the database tier. Rules are evaluated top-down; first match wins.
pbq.scenario: Allow PostgreSQL (5432/tcp) only from app subnet 10.20.0.0/24 to DB 10.30.0.10. Allow SSH only from bastion 10.0.0.5 to 10.30.0.10. Deny all other traffic to 10.30.0.10.
pbq.explanation: Permit DB traffic from the app subnet and SSH from the bastion, then deny everything else to the host.

pbq.stem: Select ALL hosts that show signs of compromise based on the logs.
pbq.scenario: Review overnight SOC excerpts and choose compromised hosts.

logs.message: Successful VPN login for adev from known home IP
Outbound DNS queries for randomized subdomains of badsite[.]top every 60s
mimikatz.exe hash dump activity blocked by EDR (alert)

pbq.explanation: WS-ACC-11 shows suspicious loader and C2-like DNS; WS-HR-09 triggered credential dumping tooling. Others look benign.

pbq.stem: Order the change-management steps for a standard production change.
pbq.scenario: Arrange the steps from first to last for a mature change process.

steps.text: Submit change request with risk and rollback plan
Implement change in the approved window
Verify success and close with post-implementation review

pbq.explanation: Request and plan → approve → implement → verify/review.

pbq.stem: Place the BEST control in each Zero Trust / segmented design slot.
pbq.scenario: Users → [Access] → Apps → [Data path] → Sensitive data store. Choose the BEST control for each slot.

slots.label: Sensitive data store
options: Encryption at rest + tight IAM + auditing
slots.answer: Encryption at rest + tight IAM + auditing

pbq.explanation: Zero Trust needs strong identity at access, encrypted authenticated service paths, and hardened data stores.

pbq.stem: Match each attack to the BEST description.
pbq.scenario: Drag the description to the matching attack name.

pairs.right: Targeted fraudulent email to a specific person/role
Replaying breached username/password pairs at scale
Rogue AP mimicking a trusted SSID
Compromising a site the target group frequents

pbq.explanation: Each term maps to a distinct delivery or credential/Wi-Fi abuse pattern.

pbq.stem: Configure edge rules for a partner API. First match wins.
pbq.scenario: Allow HTTPS from partner CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 to API VIP 203.0.113.10. Allow health checks ICMP from monitoring host 203.0.113.50 to the VIP. Deny all other inbound to the VIP.
pbq.explanation: Permit partner HTTPS and monitoring ICMP, then explicit deny for the VIP.
